phases.description: Pinned source/tree and published-hash comparisons preceded acquisition. Their original byte-unverified statements apply at their recorded phase.
Separately authorized bytes acquired and inventoried as inert data.
One DLL parsed as bytes. The adjacent executable was blocked during an independent hash-read attempt; no alternate access.
Literal parsing, integer permutations and bounded constant transforms, followed by independent mathematical checks. No Lua state-machine emulation or runtime invocation.
A separately acquired anonymous archive matched its selected reputation-platform file hash and pinned Git blob. Identifying metadata is withheld; static comparison is limited as described below.

known_K2.hash_boundary: Git blob SHA-1 hashes Git object framing plus bytes. Archive SHA-256 hashes file bytes. They are distinct identifiers.
known_K2.launcher_observation: The launcher is intended to pass the text-named Lua member to the adjacent executable. This intended invocation was not run.
known_K2.zip_metadata_limit: ZIP timestamps are untrusted metadata, not verified build dates.

runtime_markers: Lua C API and FFI exports
known_K2_PE.interpretation: Compatible interpreter-runtime structure and strings; not a proof of malicious behavior, an unmodified upstream build or authentic provenance.

strings_scope.limit: Bounded selected-string review is not a complete encoded-indicator search.

adjacent_executable_limit.reported_local_error: Operation did not complete successfully because the file contains a virus or potentially unwanted software.
adjacent_executable_limit.interpretation: The local protection message is not a malware-family label. Acquisition inventory hash is attributed to that earlier process. No protection setting was changed or alternate read attempted.

known_K2_Lua.literal_phase_limit: Zero URL/IP/contract matches applies only to decoded quoted-literal and fixed-permutation values. It does not imply absence of network behavior or include later constant transforms.

constant_transform_method.word_byte_consumption: Each 32-bit word is split low-byte to high-byte; pop-last consumption uses the high byte first.
constant_transform_method.rejection_rule: The modulo 257 recurrence repeats until its state differs from 1; the trusted decoder caps this at 256 iterations.
constant_transform_method.data_combination: Cipher byte, generated byte and previous decoded byte are added modulo 256.
constant_transform_method.input_bounds: Each transform rejects ciphertext longer than 10000 bytes or a seed outside [0,2^53).
constant_transform_method.limit: Pure data arithmetic only; no sample function or plaintext evaluation.

known_K2_Lua.straight_line_method: Bindings discarded at lexical branches, joins, loops, function boundaries and after opaque calls; unsupported assignments discarded. Only pure constant data transformations retained.

independent_math_check.limits: Recomputing outputs verifies arithmetic. Only five selected original source-pair proofs were independently checked; no reachability or opaque-callee proof for the remaining candidates.

recovered_content_categories: Windows C/FFI and PE/PEB/LDR declaration text
An eth_call JSON template with destination/data placeholders
known_K2_Lua.rpc_template_limit: The template supplies no recovered concrete contract, getter or endpoint. It is content evidence, not an observed RPC request.
known_K2_Lua.false_positive_control: A dotted browser-version token in a user-agent string was not promoted to an IP indicator.

harmless_source_span_reference.interpretation: A harmless identifier recovered as data from a fixed chunk order. This does not resolve a runtime DLL path or establish the identifier is used. Only the selected literal source data is reproduced; the complete Lua and payload code are not included.

primary_transform_reference.limit: Algorithm comparison only; shared transform structure does not establish obfuscator attribution, malware family or operator.

primary_transform_license_attribution.license_description: Custom attribution license; no SPDX or MIT classification inferred.
primary_transform_license_attribution.attribution: Based on Prometheus by Elias Oelschner, https://github.com/prometheus-lua/Prometheus

known_K2_Lua.behavior_limit: Recovered names/declarations/fragments do not establish actual injection, persistence, screen capture, network traffic or a victim event. State-dependent configuration and execution remain unresolved.

trusted_tools.tool_origin: Existing local trusted Python and pefile; explicitly authored inspection scripts. No sample-derived executable arguments.

actual_recorded_K2_Lua_processes.scope: Four recorded initial trusted data-inspection subprocesses plus one separately recorded straight-line inspection subprocess. This is not a census of all analyst commands.

anonymous_later_comparison.adjacent_skill_text_observation: The adjacent task-guidance text did not mention archive/runtime indicators among the seven explicit string checks. This negative check does not establish a complete behavioral audit.
anonymous_later_comparison.same_archive_shape: Launcher, text-named Lua member, executable and DLL. Their bytes differ from the known K2 members.
anonymous_later_comparison.structural_comparison: Similar fixed chunk-permutation and flattened numeric-state structure, with different arithmetic constants. No shared operator or malware family inferred.
anonymous_later_comparison.PE_access_limit: The first inert PE member read returned local OSError Invalid argument. The reader stopped; no PE parse or independent PE hash succeeded. Cause and malware family were not established; no alternate access attempted.
anonymous_later_comparison.limits: No archive/member filenames, hashes, source identifiers, exact byte sizes, arithmetic constants or identifying timestamps are disclosed for this unconfirmed repository.

other_acquisition_attempt.limit: Unavailable download does not establish deletion, takedown or later payload behavior.

limits: Static content evidence is distinct from execution and operator attribution.
No full source/VM deobfuscation, live endpoint request, target process execution, memory loading, security-setting change or external sample upload.

Tool/receipt hashes identify inspection provenance. No full sample, full ciphertext table or recovered command/code payload is included. A separate bounded public replay provides only one 174-byte ciphertext and its placeholders-only JSON template.
publication_status: Prepared for owner review; not published.

bounded_walkthrough_replay.classification: Unscaled detail excerpts from native editor captures of inert source and analyst-written Python; saved stdout is replay evidence, not sample execution.

constant_pair.content: eth_call JSON template with %s placeholders only

checks: Original excerpt hashes and byte spans
One-based literal indices and byte bounds
Benign three-digit escape and out-of-range rejection checks
bounded_walkthrough_replay.limits: Earlier lexical proof supplies the constant relationship. Opaque callee identity and runtime reachability are unresolved. No endpoint, contract, selector or provider is recovered. The walkthrough never loads the complete Lua.
bounded_walkthrough_replay.execution_boundary: Only analyst-authored Python was executed. No Lua, VM, sample function, recovered command, API behavior or network request.

bounded_original_file_views.classification: Complete original-byte editor inputs and analyst-generated binary rendering, represented by unscaled native-capture detail excerpts.
bounded_original_file_views.original_file_capture: Unscaled composite of the opening of complete unchanged icon16.txt and the complete original App.bat launcher line. The inventory is excluded from the detail image; all four member identities, sizes and acquisition hashes remain in the article table.
bounded_original_file_views.dll_byte_capture: Unscaled excerpt of analyst-generated hexadecimal text showing the original DLL size, SHA-256, MZ and PE signatures. No inventory or parsed section table is shown. Not DLL source, decompilation or a Hex Editor session.
bounded_original_file_views.inventory_scope: All four K2 archive members, complete member sizes and acquisition SHA-256 values. Resolver measurements remain acquisition-only after its later blocked independent read.
bounded_original_file_views.limits: Original bytes and a derived byte rendering do not establish runtime behavior or an authentic unmodified upstream runtime. Withheld second-archive identity is outside these views.
bounded_original_file_views.figure_provenance: Exact native-original and v1-input hashes, v2 dimensions, crop rectangles, panel placements and retained annotations/redactions are recorded in figures.json. Full-frame originals and v1 derivatives remain private.

public_constant_replay.scope: One fixed 174-byte constant-data relation; analyst-authored standard-library arithmetic, not sample execution.
public_constant_replay.plaintext_encoding: UTF-8, LF line endings, exactly one final LF; 174 bytes.

verification.independent_check: Original 34-chunk reconstruction, seed expression and separate integer recomputation matched the fixed relation.

public_constant_replay.source_hash_boundary: Original Lua and source-span hashes are provenance metadata; this helper does not obtain or revalidate those source files.
